scripts.export-nojekyll: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll', ''); if (fs.existsSync('public/assets')) fs.cpSync('public/assets', 'out/assets', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('public/logo.jpeg')) fs.copyFileSync('public/logo.jpeg', 'out/logo.jpeg'); if (fs.existsSync('public/favicon.ico')) fs.copyFileSync('public/favicon.ico', 'out/favicon.ico');"
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run export-nojekyll
